pkgmetadata.longdescription: WebSocket relay server (crates/buzz-relay, binary "buzz-relay") for the Buzz hive-mind communication platform. It is a Nostr relay that stores every message, reaction, workflow step, and git event as a signed event in one log, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. This package builds only the buzz-relay binary out of the buzz cargo workspace; see app-misc/buzz for the CLI client.
